description: Compare electricity plans for your home in deregulated Texas, priced on what your home actually uses. Share a photo of your electricity bill and ask whether you are overpaying. The app reads your ESI ID, meter number, and provider from the bill, pulls 12 months of 15-minute usage from Smart Meter Texas, and shows plans ranked by estimated monthly cost at your real usage. Homes with solar see Meter's solar buyback plans (Saver and Earner) priced with the power they send back to the grid; homes without solar see a comparison across providers. You can start from a ZIP code and monthly kWh instead. Filter by contract term, provider, or 100% renewable energy. Covers major providers (TXU, Reliant, Octopus, Gexa, Rhythm, Cirro, Champion, and more) across every Texas utility territory (Oncor, CenterPoint, AEP Texas, TNMP, Lubbock). Comparisons are curated and may include Meter plans; they are not an exhaustive cheapest-plan list. Estimates are approximate. Pulling usage creates a Smart Meter Texas data-sharing agreement for that meter. The app records search analytics and links to provider signup pages; it does not enroll you or change your service.

defaultPrompt: Here's my electricity bill. Am I overpaying?
Pull my home's smart meter data and find me a cheaper 12-month plan.
Compare electricity plans for 75201 at 1,000 kWh a month.
